semiconductor_relevance: High — Gazer Semiconductor Tech specializes in advanced measurement and inspection equipment for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Gazer Semiconductor Tech (Suzhou) Co., LTD focuses on technological advancements in optical measurement and inspection equipment, catering to the semiconductor sector among others. The company operates professional testing laboratories and semiconductor equipment assembly workshops, aiming to become a leading high-end semiconductor equipment manufacturer.

regional_presence.China: The company has manufacturing and operational facilities located in Suzhou, China.
